hook: Going away? Your fridge has a secret holiday setting.
doThis: Holiday mode, right on the control panel.

steps.say: Select Holiday or Vacation on the panel.
Switch back to normal a day before you're home.
steps.text: Back to normal a day early

safety.say: Don't leave fresh food in there while it's on.
safety.text: No fresh food while it's on.

result.say: The freezer keeps running, and you save energy.
result.headline: Save energy away
